name: stress-ng mpfr
description: Start N workers that exercise multi-precision floating point operations using the GNU Multi-Precision Floating Point Reliable library (mpfr). The score is the total bogo operations per second (in real time) based on wall clock run time.

environment_fields.kernel_version: Linux kernel version of the server running the benchmark (not recorded for managed databases).
environment_fields.measured_at: Timestamp (UTC) of finishing the benchmark run.
